correctness.rationale: The exact log-odds difference preserves order. The cycle is uniquely parameterized by a=8 atanh(t)/t; both transverse derivatives are 1+h and both tangential derivatives are 1-h with 0<h<2. The analytic center/odd normal form has summable squared imbalance and center errors before threshold, giving N=log(1/epsilon)/log(1+h)+O(1). Finite smooth preperiods yield a positive nonzero normal factor for every diagonal start not eventually equal to 1/2. Differentiation of h(t) proves strict monotonicity and sigma exp(a/4)->1 proves the high-gain exponent. Source theorem 3.9 supplies global diagonal convergence; finite numerical tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: A natural quantifier of how long the symmetric mixed-strategy regime persists after a small player discrepancy, measured in actual game updates. The theorem proves a sharp leading coefficient for every nonexceptional synchronized starting strategy (not just one cycle point), with bounded additive error, and identifies the counterintuitive exponentially slow transverse escape as gain increases. It complements but does not rebrand published qualitative convergence results.
